title: millet-nlrome: comparative NLR genomics across eleven grass genomes
description: Analysis code for a genome-wide comparison of NLR immune receptors and their integrated domains across eleven Poaceae genomes, with host-target phylogenetics, pathogen effector mining, expression re-analysis and codon site-model selection tests focused on blast resistance in finger millet (Eleusine coracana).
